statement: A direct developer can send business-messaging conversion events for its own WABA and dataset under Standard Access.
if_false: CAPI cannot be used directly; a Tech Provider or Solution Partner route (TP1) or no conversion signal.
test: Send a test event for a real ctwa_clid to our own dataset and see it in Events Manager.
basis: App Review page says direct developers need no Advanced access; neither CAPI guide says so for this endpoint.

statement: Meta accepts DZD as the event currency.
if_false: Convert to USD or EUR before sending, adding a rate source and rounding policy.
test: Send a DZD test event; check Events Manager.
basis: Not stated in the pages read.

statement: The WhatsApp channel we use (direct or BSP) preserves the referral object and ctwa_clid.
if_false: Attribution is lost silently; the provider choice must change.
test: Real click-to-WhatsApp entry through the chosen channel; confirm clid in our webhook.
basis: Wrappers are reported to drop or relocate the referral.

statement: Meta Business Agent is authorized for businesses based in Algeria and handles Darja and Arabizi acceptably.
if_false: Use our own conversation runtime (own_templates, own_encoder) and keep the agent out of the plan.
test: Read the authorized-country list; try enabling; score it on a labelled set.
basis: Overview requires an authorized country; press says global; no dialect evidence.

statement: Algerian counsel permits the additional flows to foreign providers: conversion dispatch, hosted LLM on redacted text, Meta's agent, and Z2 hosting location.
if_false: No personal data leaves Algeria beyond the channel itself; CAPI with ctwa_clid and any hosted LLM are off.
test: Written opinion on the flows in section 14.1.
basis: Law summary read; specifics conflict across sources.

statement: An Algerian business can fund Meta ads and WhatsApp billing with an instrument Meta accepts.
if_false: No ads and no paid messaging from our own account; an agency or partner billing route is needed.
test: Add a payment method in Ads Manager and WhatsApp Manager; reconcile a small charge.
basis: Meta's country list was not retrievable; trade sources report CIB and Edahabia are generally rejected.

statement: An Algerian entity can complete Meta business verification.
if_false: All account-level steps stall.
test: Start verification with the entity's documents.
basis: Requirements not read.

statement: Our conversational agent is incidental to a business service, not an AI Provider under the Business Solution Terms.
if_false: WhatsApp access could be refused or removed in Meta's sole discretion; positioning and scope must change.
test: Counsel review of the terms and our positioning; ask Meta Direct Support in writing if available.
basis: Clause text seen second-hand; the test is Meta's own discretion.

statement: Training or fine-tuning our NLU on our WhatsApp conversations stays inside the exclusive-use exception.
if_false: Training data must come from synthetic and public Darja corpora only; no vendor may touch conversation-derived data.
test: Counsel review plus architecture check: model private, dataset unshared, no vendor training.
basis: Exception text read on the terms page; its application to a classifier head is unreviewed.

statement: Couriers, the payment PSP and an LLM vendor are Third Party Service Providers under the terms.
if_false: Sharing customer data with them breaches the terms.
test: Read the definition; sign written terms with each.
basis: Definition not read.

statement: Lead tagging (HOT, WARM, COLD) and per-contact attribution are not profile building on individual WhatsApp users.
if_false: Remove scoring or confine it to message-thread content.
test: Counsel review against the profile-building clause and its message-thread exception.
basis: Clause read; application unreviewed.

statement: A user-initiated click-to-WhatsApp conversation is sufficient opt-in for service replies and utility updates; marketing needs separate opt-in.
if_false: Add explicit opt-in capture before order updates outside the 24-hour window.
test: Counsel review of the policy and local law.
basis: Opt-in may be general per policy; sufficiency unreviewed.

statement: Per-message costs in Algeria are acceptable: the sales conversation fits the 72-hour free window and post-window updates are cheap enough.
if_false: Cut notification count or move updates to another channel.
test: Read Algeria's rate card and model cost per order.
basis: Rate not retrieved.

statement: Sending the purchase signal at delivery improves optimisation versus sending it at confirmation.
if_false: Send earlier, accepting returns in the signal.
test: A/B the trigger on live campaigns.
basis: Meta says purchase optimisation exists; says nothing about COD timing.

statement: Last click before order creation selects the right ctwa_clid.
if_false: Audit mismatches and change the rule.
test: Compare chosen clids with Meta-reported conversions on a sample.
basis: Judgment.

statement: Algerian courier APIs are available to us with verified accounts, and commune-name mismatches are manageable.
if_false: Manual parcel creation or a unified wrapper.
test: Open courier accounts and create sandbox parcels.
basis: Vendor docs and plugin pages.

statement: A domestic payment-link rail does not cost more conversion than it gains in cash certainty.
if_false: Stay COD-only.
test: A/B test.
basis: Single vendor claim.

statement: Records keyed by an opaque id with a Z1 identity map are not personal data.
if_false: Treat the event log as personal data everywhere.
test: Counsel opinion.
basis: Conservative default already treats them as personal.

statement: Meta policies, terms, pricing and API versions change often enough to need a 30 to 90 day re-verification cycle.
if_false: Shorten or lengthen the cycle.
test: Track diffs of the key pages over two or three cycles.
basis: Policy says changes may occur without notice; two CAPI guide versions coexist.

statement: The Cloud API test number is enough to test webhooks, signatures, message flow and status events without a business WhatsApp account.
if_false: A real WABA is needed even for plumbing tests.
test: Set up the test number, point the webhook at our endpoint, send a message.
basis: Get Started page; limits on referrals known.

statement: Phase 1 operates for businesses we own or control, as a direct developer, not as a multi-merchant platform.
if_false: Tech Provider onboarding, App Review, per-customer billing and heavier scrutiny under the AI Providers clause become required.
test: Decision by the project owner.
basis: Not stated by the owner; assumed from the single-business framing.
